name: Maizuru (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Maizuru city emblem in maroon: a crescent open at the top enclosing a stylised crane's head.
history: Municipal flag of Maizuru, a city in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 January 1944.

features.role: Maizuru city emblem — a crescent open at the top enclosing a stylised crane's head
